digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite and CI workflows
propositions: External integration tests currently run live against only Anthropic provider, leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regressions undetectable by CI automation
Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in workflows rather than ambient default, with each arm running once per credentialed provider
Each provider arm must select its provider via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a config file setting [llm.model_classes], not via deprecated REBAR_LLM_MODEL
Missing credentials must skip loudly and be distinguishable from successful runs, never reading as silent green
Bedrock arm must obtain credentials via OIDC role assumption to dedicated scoped role, not fall back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and must explicitly set both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION
Config overlay must repoint the ambient default model per provider arm to prevent unintended cross-provider calls
